title: Provenance
description: Where a record came from. Embedded in every record so any datum can be traced back to its source. This is the audit trail that lets us show the receipt when a score is disputed.

source_url.description: Canonical https URL the data was read from.

scraped_at.description: UTC timestamp when the content was fetched.

ingest_method.description: How it entered the system. 'manual_url' records are staged, never trusted straight into live scores.

parser_version.description: Version of the parser, for replayability when parsing logic changes.

content_hash.description: sha256 of the raw source content, to detect drift / tampering.
